provenance.origin: Original OpenAI ImageGen artwork from approved Hàng Long concept A and the Phi Long fire palette. Registered and exported in Aseprite.

dragon_coil.prompt: Draw a production pixel-art VFX animation sheet for a Wuxia RPG. Reference 1 is approved storyboard A, use the requested phase only. Reference 2 gives the exact fire palette and stylized flaming Asian dragon head (one long dragon only, no wings, no scales, no arms or legs, its long body is entirely sculpted scarlet and tangerine fire). This is original isolated game effect art, no actors, scenery, text, UI, shadows, or tiles. Crisp well-defined clusters with red and tangerine dominant, restrained amber edges, no blurry glow. Fixed elevated 3/4 game camera. STRICT format 1536 by 1024, 3 columns by 2 rows, exactly 6 separated 512px square cels on flat pure #000000. Ample black gutters, no art touches panel edges. Each cel is the next phase in the animation, reading order. Upper left of reference 1. Six distinct consecutive phases of ONE continuous long fire dragon making one full fast clockwise lap in a WIDE LOW HORIZONTAL ELLIPSE around the invisible player. KEEP ellipse and pivot locked at local x256 y270, outer shape about 425px wide and 195px tall, empty center about 185px wide, so game character will be visible at center. Track the head moving around the ellipse one sixth of a circle each frame: front-right pointing left, front-left pointing away, rear-left pointing right, rear center pointing right, rear-right turning towards viewer, right foreground turning left. Precisely one identifiable Asian dragon head in each cel, the long flame body trails behind its head around most of the same ellipse; thinner red aftertrail indicates speed and second sweep. Foreshorten the head slightly at the rear. Same body thickness through all six, no fixed head or static rotation of the whole picture. Color naturally dims at rear and orange red highlights at front. No vertical spiral. Do not fill the center.
